    @pytest.mark.priority(13)
    @pytest.mark.description("Test case for validating form submission from coach portal")
    @allure.title(f"Given SDOH form triggered, When user Login to user portal, Then user should be able to see SDOH form with the least order and unless its submitted/skipped, user can't interact with the app")
    def test_validate_triggeredSDOHForm_from_userPortal(self):
        #SDOH form validation comes after habi persona form
        WebDriverWait(self.driver, 10).until(EC.element_to_be_clickable(("xpath", "//button[text()='Review Forms']")))
        assert self.driver.find_element("xpath", "//button[text()='Review Forms']").is_displayed(), "Review Forms button is not displayed"
        # self.driver.find_element("xpath", "//button[text()='Review Forms']").click()
        target_xpath = "//button[text()='Review Forms']"
        self.driver.execute_script("arguments[0].click();", self.driver.find_element(By.XPATH, target_xpath))
        WebDriverWait(self.driver, 10).until(EC.element_to_be_clickable(("xpath", "//p[text()='Please choose a form you would like to fill first.']")))
        assert self.driver.find_element("xpath", "//p[text()='Please choose a form you would like to fill first.']").is_displayed(), "Form selection prompt is not displayed"
